NOTE:- Entire quantity shall be supplied in single lot. I. Bid Evaluation Criteria : 1. The offer shall cover the complete scope of work at S. No. 1 for all 15 boards. Partial offers will not be considered. 2. The bidder shall complete the compliance responses in Table-1 and declare t he probable source of purchase for each BOM item in Table-2 at the time of bid. Bids without the required source details shall be liable to rejection. 3. Passive components, including resistors, capacitors, trim pots, diodes and LE Ds, shall be of make Vishay, Bourns, TE Connectivity, Ohmite, KEMET, Yageo, A VX, ON Semiconductor or equivalent make. 4. ICs shall be of make TI, Fairchild, Analog Devices, ON Semiconductor, Lattice or equivalent reputed make. 5. Connectors and switches shall be of make Phoenix, Harting, Amphenol, FCI, Molex, Essen Deinki or equivalent reputed make. 6. The bidder shall commit to procurement only from the OEM or authorized dist ributors, including Mouser, Digi-Key and Element14. Procurement shall follow th e sources declared in the bid. Any change of source requires prior RRCAT appro val. 7. The bidder shall confirm the work sequence at S. No. 8 and Figure-2: one sam ple board within 45 days of PO release and the complete supply within 70 days of written sample-board clearance. The scheduled total period is 120 days (45+ 5 + 70). . 5. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
